notes: The supplied also is folded onto καί as its adverbial realization rather than marked added; reading it as added remains defensible, since the conjunction has already been written as and.

s013 τοῖς takes that under rule 90 even though ὑμῖν stands as an expressed antecedent pronoun: the article governs no expressed head noun, so rule 31 does not apply. The same reading is taken at 2:13.
